description: Request bodies of POST /api/ingest/events and whether parseTrackingBatch accepts each. Shared by the SDK's tests, the Strapi handler's tests and the strapi-php handler's PHPUnit tests, so the three validators cannot drift. Each body is at most MAX_TRACKING_BATCH_BYTES; the size cap is tested apart.

vectors.name: every optional field, in a beacon
a whole timestamp in exponent form
a whole timestamp with a fraction of zero
the latest timestamp a Date holds
a repeated key, the last one counting
a path of every allowed character
an http referrer with a port
a surrogate pair written as escapes
a NUL character in a string
a property named like an Object method
JSON after a byte order mark
a version written as a string
a write key in a fetch batch
a beacon without a write key
a write key with a symbol
a null write key in a beacon
a sentAt beyond the Date range
a sentAt written as a string
an event that is a string
an event that is a list
a name starting with a digit
a name followed by a newline
a name that is a number
a timestamp beyond the Date range
a timestamp in exponent form beyond the range
a timestamp written as a string
a user with an at sign
a path without a leading slash
a path with a control character
a path with a non-ASCII character
an absolute URL as a path
a property key in upper case
a lone surrogate in the path
a lone surrogate in a property key
a number too large to be finite
